description: Memory-model calibration points (milestone 9 phase 1, design 4.3). Quantity: the measurement tool's steady peak_mb after the warm-up reset (design 4.1, U11). status: ok | oom | failed_d2 | range | holdout (hold-out records carry measured_status ok | oom and are never fitted). cap_gib: usable card memory for the OOM checks (RTX 8000 / A6000 approx. 47 GiB, GTX 1080 = the 6000 MB TF limit).

deform.source: m8 memory job, deform AMP both N8 step_ms

step_times.r_task_source: m8_level2_gradnorm A100 window medians 0.73 s (linear) / 4.9 s (deform) vs RTX 8000 1.16 / 7.0 s
